entities.name: J-Mail
entities.how_described: 本集说它是文件公布当晚花 5 小时做出来的玩笑式产品,可以像 Epstein 本人一样登录收件箱,到 2 月有 4.5 亿访问量、1800 万用户,后续衍生出 JFlights、JAmazon、JPhotos、JCal 等产品套件

evidence.quote: I think it's testament to the hundreds of millions of people that were using J-Mail and the tens of million that still log on from week to week nowadays.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 非结构化数据 (unstructured data)
entities.how_described: 本集说它无处不在,大多数企业文档都是非结构化的(扫描件、旋转文档、图表、潦草手写),有时候你只需要把它提取出来,之后想干什么都行

evidence.quote: Like, I think, like, unstructured data is, like, everywhere.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 智能体文档处理 (agentic document processing)
entities.how_described: 本集说 Reducto 是由智能体 OCR 框架驱动:模型不是一口气给出答案,而是标记自己不确定的地方、先纠正再进入下一步,还能对模型应用系统提示词做定制化处理

evidence.quote: So parse is really the foundation for all of these other agentic document processing features.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 提取模式 (schema)
entities.how_described: 本集把它比作 Reducto 画布上的画笔:定义要提取的字段、丢文档进去验证结果、满意就部署拿到 API 调用;嵌套限制约四五层,见过一个 156 个字段的 schema

entities.name: 涂黑脱敏 (redaction)
entities.how_described: 本集说部分官方文件的涂黑做得不合格,黑框背后能看到被遮住的人名,工具好使得过头反而把本该遮住的信息提了出来,于是 JMail 团队主动承担了补涂黑的责任,以免被起诉

evidence.quote: So sometimes, and this is honestly testament to, like, who was doing the redaction, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Sometimes the redaction was actually not that great.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so what that ended up being, the responsibility ended up being on us as the Gmail team to then have to do a bunch of redaction, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Yeah, seems like there was a lack of understanding, whoever was cooking up that redaction.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Some files were actually redacted correctly, but there was some files where we were just able to see who was, like, you know, who the redaction was behind, and so it became a really, really serious, you know, situation, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 基准测试 (benchmark)
entities.how_described: 本集说遗憾通常得自己做自己的 benchmark:客户拿 Reducto 与其他方案跑对比测试,团队帮忙调配置、说明取舍,并且经常赢

evidence.quote: To give you some context, in the last three years, we've raised $108 million from investors like ACCNC, Benchmark, and more, and processed over two billion documents across customers like Harvey, Scale, and a top five global hedge fund.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Every single one of our customers typically have some benchmark.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: RAG 聊天机器人 (RAG chatbot)

evidence.quote: To be frank with you, I came up with something that was pretty shoddy in the beginning, like basically a RAG chatbot application where you can ask anything about the emails.
